title: Independent mother antecedent and continuing materially conditioned activity (current-clock lawful portion)

classification_detail.detail: New parent_activity.py only. No existing P2Owner, house.py, P3, model_cycle, store, world or C01 reader/writer symbol was edited. Parent material state is an additive field in the existing world actor-state row.
Parent self-read/options, parent activity event/receipt, parent material history. C03 remains the future decision/utterance consumer.
B02 dated calendar/history qualification is absent. All reads and receipts carry period_qualification=HELD_B02_CALENDAR_ABSENT and historical_dates=NOT_AVAILABLE; no year/date fixture is fabricated.

parent_activity.py is a new module not currently included in P3Owner._code_pins(). P3 integration must decide whether to add it to source closure; this return does not edit or weaken P3. No native actor/science/right/human/protected authority is issued.

No second scheduler, parent world, time ledger, database, actor owner or material fact slot. Parent material state is in the existing P2 world actor-state row; activity history is in existing C12 episodes/world events.

actual_writer_trace: establish_parent_material [parent_activity.py:308] writes a source-qualified C12 P2_PARENT_MATERIAL_ANTECEDENT episode and world.actor_state[alias]['material'], then checkpoints through session.product._checkpoint. No world event is fabricated for the antecedent.

commit_parent_circumstances [parent_activity.py:427] writes a C12 P2_PARENT_CIRCUMSTANCE episode and material state at the current clock. event_effect=NONE; cash changes are refused; source_ref is required.

record_parent_activity [parent_activity.py:523] validates the registered parent and material feasibility, then atomically writes bp4.world.make_event with actor_id=parent_alias and an owner receipt, append_world_event, parent own_action perception, a C12 P2_PARENT_ACTIVITY episode, the updated material state and one P2 checkpoint.
supporting_actor._StoreWrite supplies the C12 transaction boundary reused from B's C01 receipt. No new DB/table/owner is created.

actual_reader.name: parent_activity.read_parent_material
actual_reader.returns: self-only SOROK_P2_PARENT_MATERIAL_READ@1 with material fields, source/binding/clock and B02 hold

actual_reader.name: parent_activity.parent_feasible_actions
actual_reader.consumes: the parent's actual current material state
actual_reader.returns: self-only SOROK_P2_PARENT_FEASIBLE_ACTIONS@1 with PAID_WORK/CARE_DEPENDENT/PAY_DEBT ADMISSIBLE/REFUSED reasons; not a decision

actual_reader.name: parent_activity.read_parent_activity
actual_reader.consumes: C12 parent activity episode plus actual world event
actual_reader.returns: self-only public event projection and stored receipt

actual_reader.name: parent_activity.read_parent_history
actual_reader.returns: self-only operation/source/event history with B02 hold

new_actual_first_reader: parent_activity.parent_feasible_actions (self-only actual current material options). The next consumer is C03 parent decision/utterance; C03 is not implemented.
